## Purpose and entry points
Kolibri is an offline-first teaching and learning platform, deployed as a local server with browser, Android, desktop, Debian, and Raspberry Pi delivery options. Python entry points are `kolibri/__main__.py`, `kolibri/main.py`, and Django WSGI at `kolibri/deployment/default/wsgi.py`; request routing begins in `kolibri/deployment/default/urls.py` and `kolibri/core/urls.py`.

## Server composition and plugin boundary
The backend is a Django application organized into core domain apps plus discoverable Kolibri plugins. Plugin registration and defaults are centered on `kolibri/plugins/registry.py`, `kolibri/plugins/hooks.py`, and `kolibri/utils/build_config/default_plugins.py`. Plugins pair Django routes/viewsets/templates with independently bundled frontend applications; e.g. `kolibri/plugins/learn/kolibri_plugin.py`, `kolibri/plugins/learn/urls.py`, and `kolibri/plugins/learn/frontend/app.js`.

## Identity, facilities, and authorization
The auth domain owns facility datasets, users, roles, classrooms, memberships, sessions, permissions, and facility synchronization operations. Primary boundaries are data models and authorization in `kolibri/core/auth/models.py`, `kolibri/core/auth/permissions/`, and REST-facing viewsets in `kolibri/core/auth/viewsets/`. User sign-in and signup UI is a separate plugin consuming these APIs: `kolibri/plugins/user_auth/frontend/app.js` and `kolibri/plugins/user_auth/viewsets.py`.

## Content lifecycle and local storage
Content is represented as channels, content-node trees, files, and requests. It supports import/export, granular selection, search, transfer, deletion, and upgrades through `kolibri/core/content/models.py`, `kolibri/core/content/utils/channel_import.py`, and `kolibri/core/content/utils/content_export.py`. This is a key offline boundary: content metadata/schema and local files are managed separately, including versioned content database schema under `kolibri/core/content/contentschema/` and SQLite-oriented deployment support in `kolibri/deployment/default/db/backends/sqlite3/base.py`.

## Learning, coaching, and progress flow
Learners browse channels or assignments, launch a content viewer, and record progress/attempts. Learning UI lives in `kolibri/plugins/learn/frontend/`, while content-node progress API behavior is in `kolibri/core/content/viewsets/contentnode/progress.py`. Lessons, quizzes/exams, courses, and event logging are persisted by `kolibri/core/lessons/models.py`, `kolibri/core/exams/models.py`, `kolibri/core/courses/models.py`, and `kolibri/core/logger/models.py`. Coaches consume aggregated reports and notifications through `kolibri/plugins/coach/viewsets/` and `kolibri/plugins/coach/frontend/`.

## Async work, sync, and device networking
Long-running imports, exports, content transfers, sync, and maintenance are represented by the internal task system: `kolibri/core/tasks/job.py`, `kolibri/core/tasks/worker.py`, and `kolibri/core/tasks/registry.py`. Device provisioning/settings and sync queues are owned by `kolibri/core/device/models.py` and `kolibri/core/device/tasks.py`. Peer discovery and network-location management are separate in `kolibri/core/discovery/` and `kolibri/core/discovery/utils/network/`. Facility synchronization integrates Morango concepts via `kolibri/core/auth/sync_operations.py`; remote portal/data-portal interaction is exposed in frontend resources such as `packages/kolibri-common/apiResources/PortalResource.js`.

## Frontend and viewer runtime
The frontend is JavaScript/Vue with shared application shell, API client/resources, router, state utilities, and UI components in `packages/kolibri/`, `packages/kolibri-common/`, and `packages/kolibri-i18n/`. Webpack build integration is in `packages/kolibri-build/` and server-side asset/template integration in `kolibri/core/webpack/`. Specialized viewer plugins render EPUB, PDF, media, HTML5, Bloom, Perseus, QTI, and slides; untrusted/interactive content is isolated through the sandbox runtime in `packages/kolibri-sandbox/src/`.

## Deployment surfaces
The default runtime is a Python/Django local server, containerizable through `docker/Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`. Native shells start or embed that server: Android WebView/service code in `platforms/android/app/src/main/java/org/learningequality/Kolibri/`, desktop process management in `platforms/desktop-app/src/kolibri_app/kolibri_process.py`, and Debian service/reverse-proxy definitions in `platforms/debian-server/debian/kolibri-server.service` and `platforms/debian-server/nginx.conf`.
